surface_id.description: Optional surface id for begin (defaults to chat:turn:<turnId>).

verb.description: Atomic builder verb. Chain begin → add_* / set_* → done.

contracts.name: cognition_ui_present
contracts.description: Publish a new HTML artifact in chat as an inline card, side panel, or fullscreen view. To pin it on a custom canvas surface, set persist, surface_id, component_id, and slot. Revise published HTML with cognition_store_write action=artifacts.write.

height.description: Optional inline max height hint in pixels (default ~360)

html.description: HTML fragment or document. For panel/fullscreen prefer transparent outer background; avoid full-page black fills. Card layouts up to ~900px centered are ideal. Persisted canvas widgets: use MedousaStore (not localStorage); await MedousaStore.get/set/delete — see cognition_environment_wiki(topic=artifact_runtime).

persist.description: When true, also upsert a presentation component on the environment canvas

presentation.description: How Home should render the artifact

slot.description: Slot zone for persisted component (default main)

surface_id.description: Custom surface id for a persisted component.

title.description: Short label shown in the artifact header/chip

contracts.name: cognition_ui_scene
contracts.description: Build a native streamable scene from scene-op JSON. Start with plan_layout, then fill slots in small batches. Ops: plan_layout, fill_slot, patch_props, set_binding, set_fill_state, precompute, remove.

ops.description: Ordered scene operations. Each item is an object with a string op field (plan_layout, fill_slot, patch_props, set_binding, set_fill_state, precompute, remove). Keep batches small — plan_layout first, then fill_slot in follow-up calls.

surface_id.description: Optional scene surface id. Defaults to the chat turn surface.

contracts.name: cognition_utility_day_of_week
contracts.description: Return weekday for a YYYY-MM-DD date, or for today when date is omitted.

contracts.name: cognition_utility_time_now
contracts.description: Return current time in UTC and local timezone, including weekday and unix timestamp.

contracts.name: cognition_utility_uuid
contracts.description: Generate UUID helper values for correlation, trace, and idempotency keys.

contracts.name: cognition_web_search
contracts.description: Search the public web with one call. The registered backend selects provider bindings and fallbacks.

mode.description: Search directly or use a configured research pipeline

try_fallbacks.description: Try lower-priority bindings when the preferred provider fails

contracts.name: cognition_workshop_mutate
contracts.description: Write workshop/worker control: spawn, cancel, or steer. action is a typed name (workshop.spawn, workshop.cancel, workshop.steer). Fetch fields with cognition_schema types=[...].

contracts.name: cognition_workshop_query
contracts.description: Read workshop/worker status and authorized targets. action is a typed name (workshop.status, workshop.targets). Fetch fields with cognition_schema types=[...].

contracts.name: artifacts_fetch
contracts.title: Fetch artifact
contracts.description: Fetch an artifact by id (optional session_id).

contracts.name: artifacts_list
contracts.title: List artifacts
contracts.description: List workshop artifacts.

contracts.name: calendar_list
contracts.title: List calendar events
contracts.description: List calendar events in a time range for the bound workshop.

contracts.name: vault_list
contracts.title: List vault notes
contracts.description: List notes under the bound workshop vault (paths only).

contracts.name: vault_read
contracts.title: Read vault note
contracts.description: Read a vault markdown note by relative path.

contracts.name: vault_search
contracts.title: Search vault
contracts.description: Grep/search vault note bodies.
